items.title: Leslie Johnson interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 12, 2007
items.q: The transcript identifies Monk Rowe as the interviewer and Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive, but the interviewee does not mention any personal or professional relationship with him beyond the interview context.

ctx.x: Leslie was interviewed in New York City on January 12, 2007 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.

My name is Monk Rowe and we are filming in Manhattan at the IAJE. I’m pleased to have Leslie Johnson, editor of The Mississippi Rag with me. And this is — we’ve had a long list of interviewees but you are our first editor of a publication.
So you’ve done just musicians up to this point?
